_comment: Mudge House (CMU 050), a residence hall on a hillside. A is the basement below ground floor 1. Room numbers are wing letter + floor + two digits (C205A); floor A uses wing + number (C19). Stairs are found from the drawn treads. On floors 2-3 the corridor color is shared with 315 office service in the key; it is corridor here. Floor 3's Type sheet is colored by department, so its rooms borrow types from the same rooms on floor 2.
